note: The packages that the sandbox image owns. The emitter drops an edge into one of these names, because no store directory holds it. A name here is dropped only when the resolved set holds no node of that name, thus a package that the store does install keeps its edge. Python names match after PEP 503 normalization. R names match verbatim, because R package names are case-sensitive.
rule: A build that stops on a revealed name gives one decision, and the two files answer it. The sandbox imports the package: add the name to images/package-store/manifest.yaml. The sandbox image carries the package: add the name here. A name here that the image does not own drops a real edge, thus the closure runs short and the import fails inside the sandbox. ImageOwnedPackageTests in test_provision.py holds this file to the image.
